course_name_original: Fundamentos matemáticos de la ingeniería i (20224006)
prerequisites: Basic knowledge of operations with polynomials, powers, roots, and logarithms is necessary.

learning_outcomes.text: Correctly applies mathematical principles that may arise in engineering, linear algebra, geometry, differential geometry, differential and integral calculus, differential and partial differential equations, numerical methods, numerical algorithms, statistics, and optimization.

Acquires the ability to use basic mathematical tools in modeling and solving engineering-related situations. The techniques studied are those related to linear algebra and univariate and multivariate analysis.

syllabus_topics: Definition and matrix representation of systems of linear equations.
Vector space. Bases. Change of bases.
Definition of complex numbers. Real and imaginary part.
Transformation from one representation to another.
Examples of usual functions. Domain of a function.
Basic concepts of differentiation. Differentiation rules. Chain rule. Applications of differentiation in solving limits. Taylor series.
Basic concepts of integration. Integration methods (immediate, by parts, for trigonometric and rational functions). Applications of integration.
teaching_methods: Problem/exercise solving in the ordinary classroom

assessment_methods.method: Problem/exercise solving in the ordinary classroom (short tests)

assessment_rules: In the 2nd call, the problem-solving grade (20%) will be maintained, and a written exam covering all course topics (80%) will be conducted. For the 2nd partial exam, a minimum grade of 3/10 is required. Fraudulent use of any means in evaluative tests is prohibited and will result in a failing grade for that activity.
